name: Knight of Celephaïs
text:
Dreaming 4.
Knight of Celephaïs may be assigned damage and/or horror dealt to other investigators at your location.
[reaction] When Knight of Celephaïs is defeated: Remove 1 dream from a dreaming card you control.

name: Knight's Longsword
text: Dreaming 3. [action]: Fight ([combat]). This attack deals +1 damage. If this attack defeats an enemy, you may exhaust Knight's Longsword to remove 1 dream from a dreaming card you control.

flavor: The power of your dreams in the palm of your hand.
name: Dream Mastery
text: If this skill test is successful, remove 1 dream from a dreaming card controlled by an investigator at your location.

name: Oathsworn
text: Attach to an [[Ally]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location. Attached asset gets +1 health and +1 sanity. [reaction] When attached asset would be defeated: Discard Oathsworn instead. Flip attached asset facedown and place 1 resource (from the token pool) on it, as a dream.

name: Somnium Shotcaster
text: Dreaming 2. Fast. Uses (4 ammo). [reaction] When Somnium Shotcaster enters play: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at any location. [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: Grimoire of Ages
text:
Dreaming 2. Uses (3 secrets).
[reaction] After Grimoire of Ages enters play: Move 1 dream from a dreaming card you control to another dreaming card you control.
[fast] During your turn, spend 1 secret and exhaust Grimoire of Ages: Choose an investigator at your location to draw 1 card.

name: Lunar Charts
text: Dreaming 3. Uses (3 secrets). [action] Spend 1 secret: Investigate ([intellect]). You get +2 [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, you may move 1 dream from a dreaming card you control to another dreaming card you control.

name: Oneiric Insight
text: Choose an investigator to search the top 9 cards of their deck for a level 0 non-weakness asset. That investigator plays that asset as if it had dreaming X, where X is that asset's printed resource cost. That investigator shuffles their deck.

name: Light of Ilarnek
text:
Dreaming 2. Fast. Play only during your turn.
Discover 1 clue at your location. Then, attach Light of Ilarnek to any revealed location. Limit 1 per location.
Attached location gets -2 shroud.

name: Idol of Bokrug
text: Dreams may be moved to and from Idol of Bokrug as if it were a dreaming card under your control. Forced - After your turn begins: Move 1 dream from a dreaming card you control to Idol of Bokrug. (Limit 5 dreams on Idol of Bokrug.) [action]: Move all dreams from Idol of Bokrug to an asset you control with uses (secrets), as secrets.

name: Dalkura
text: Dreaming 3. [action] Spend 1-5 resources and exhaust Dalkura: Parley. Choose a card in your hand with dreaming X, where X is the number of resources spent as part of this ability's cost. Play the chosen card, ignoring all costs.

name: Corsair's Cache
text:
Dreaming 3.
Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator searches the top 9 cards of their deck for an [[Item]] card and either adds it to their hand, or discards it and gains resources equal to its printed cost. That investigator shuffles their deck.

name: Double Team
text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location attacks an enemy.
Add your [agility] to the performing investigator's skill value for this attack. If that attack succeeds by 2 or more, automatically evade the attacked enemy.

name: Blade of the Sky-Sea
text: Dreaming 2. [action]: Fight ([combat]). You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If the attacked enemy is exhausted, this attack deals +1 damage. If you succeed, gain 1 resource.

name: Boarding Party
text: Fight ([combat]). You get +3 [combat] and deal +2 damage for this attack. After this attack resolves, you may exhaust an [[Ally]] asset you control to resolve this ability a second time.

name: Enchanting Fife
text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Exhaust Enchanting Fife and either spend 1 charge or place 1 resource (from the token pool) on a dreaming card you control, as a dream: Parley. Heal 1 horror from a card controlled by an investigator at your location. That card's controller may draw a card.

name: Luke Robinson
text: Dreaming 3. Forced - When Luke Robinson enters play: Heal 1 damage, gain 1 resource, and replenish 1 charge on an asset you control. [fast] During a skill test on a [[Spell]] card, flip Luke Robinson facedown and place 2 of your resources on him, as dreams: You get +2 skill value for this test. (Max once per round.)

name: Veil of Thalarion
text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location would take damage and/or horror. Reduce this card's cost by 1 for each dream on 1 dreaming card you control.
Cancel all of that damage and/or horror.

flavor: To learn the secrets forbidden to all except the most worthy.
name: Sigil of Thalarion
text:
Permanent. Limit 1 [[Sigil]] per investigator.
[reaction] When your turn ends, if you control a dreaming card with 5 or more dreams: Play a card with dreaming X from your hand.

name: Lunar Sight
text: Dreaming 3. Uses (4 charges). [action]: Investigate ([willpower]). When you activate this ability, you may spend 1 charge. If you do, your location gets -2 shroud for this test, and if you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at your location. If a [skull] is revealed during this skill test, you must either place 1 resource (from the token pool) on a dreaming card you control, as a dream, or take 1 horror and discard this card.

name: Reality Fracture
text: Dreaming 3. Uses (4 charges). [action]: Fight ([willpower]). When you activate this ability, you may spend 1 charge. If you do, the attacked enemy gets -2 fight for this test, and if you succeed this attack deals +1 damage. If a [cultist] is revealed during this skill test, you must either place 1 resource (from the token pool) on a dreaming card you control, as a dream, or take 1 damage and discard this card.

name: Explorer's Sextant
text: Dreaming 2. [action]: Investigate ([intellect]). You get +1 [intellect] for this investigation. If you fail, flip a non-weakness, non-story asset you control facedown and place 3 resources on it (from the token pool), as dreams. If you succeed, you may exhaust Explorer's Sextant to discover 1 additional clue at your location.

name: Dream Quest
text: You may play Dream Quest from your discard pile. As an additional cost to do so, flip a non-weakness, non-story asset you control facedown and place 2 resources (from the token pool) on it, as dreams. If you do, place Dream Quest on the bottom of your deck after it resolves. Investigate ([intellect]). You get +2 [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, you may draw 1 card.

name: Dreams of Peace
text:
Dreaming 2.
Either discard a non-peril, non-weakness treachery from your threat area, or heal 1 damage and 1 horror.

name: Lash of Ulthar
text: Dreaming 2. [action]: Fight ([combat]). You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If you fail, flip a non-weakness, non-story asset you control facedown and place 2 resources on it (from the token pool), as dreams. If you succeed and the attacked enemy is non-[[Elite]], you may exhaust Lash of Ulthar to automatically evade that enemy.

name: Staff of Atal
text:
You may control 1 additional dreaming card.
[reaction] After an asset you control is flipped facedown, exhaust Staff of Atal: Discover 1 clue at your location and move 1 dream from a dreaming card you control to your resource pool, as a resource.

flavor:
"So that men walk through it as through a faery place, and feel greater joy and wonder than they ever afterward remember."
—H.P. Lovecraft, The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath
name: Call of the Dreamlands
text: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Dreamlands]] card and play it, reducing its cost or dreaming value by 1. Shuffle your deck.
